def solve():
    cost = Q(65000)
    dep = cost / 6
    carry2 = cost - 2 * dep
    rec2 = cost * Q("0.33")
    impairment = max(carry2 - rec2, Q(0))
    carry2_after = carry2 - impairment
    dep_new = carry2_after / 4
    carry3 = carry2_after - dep_new
    ceiling = cost - 3 * dep
    rec3 = cost * Q("0.52")
    target = min(rec3, ceiling)
    reversal = max(target - carry3, Q(0))
    carry_final = carry3 + reversal
    assets = Q(220000) + carry_final
    ratio = Q(290000) / assets * 100
    headroom = Q(55) - ratio
    return {
        "final": headroom,
        "impairment_loss": impairment,
        "carrying_pre_reversal": carry3,
        "reversal_ceiling": ceiling,
        "reversal_recognized": reversal,
    }
